annotation.title_clean: 关于开展基层医疗卫生机构医疗质量改善三年行动(2026—2028年)的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Launching the Three-Year Action to Improve Medical Quality in Primary Healthcare Institutions (2026–2028)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委办公厅 (General Office of the National Health Commission)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese National Health Commission notice launching a three-year (2026–2028) action plan to improve medical quality management in primary healthcare institutions, with phased deployment, annual self-inspection, rectification, evaluation and final summary. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three-year medical quality improvement action in primary care institutions 2026–2028
Township hospitals and large community centres to establish quality management systems by end-2026; others by 2027
Village clinics and community stations brought into the system by 2028
Annual cycle of self-inspection, improvement and evaluation
Local health authorities and medical consortia lead hospitals supervise and verify
